functions.name: create-post
functions.description: Create a board post attributed to an existing user, optionally recording an admin acting on their behalf.

url.description: Board URL filtered to the tag.

boardId.description: Owning Canny board ID.

FunctionOutput_canny_createtag.description: The new or existing board-specific tag returned by Canny.

functions.name: create-vote
functions.description: Create a user's vote on a post, optionally attributed to an administrator or dated to its original creation in another system. Success also covers a vote that already exists.

byId.description: Canny user identifier of the administrator casting the vote on behalf of the voter. Omit for a vote without explicit administrator attribution.

postId.description: Canny identifier of the existing post receiving the vote.

voterId.description: Canny user identifier of the voter, not the user's external user ID.

priority.description: Requested priority of the new vote. Omit to use Canny's default; this does not request a change to an existing vote.

createdAt.description: Original creation instant for a vote imported from another source, with an explicit UTC marker or offset. Omit for ordinary vote creation. Fractional seconds must be preserved without rounding.

FunctionInput_canny_createvote.description: Create a vote for an existing Canny user and post, with optional administrator attribution, priority, and original creation time.

postId.description: Canny identifier of the post specified in the request.

status.description: Canny accepted the request as a newly created or already existing vote; these outcomes cannot be distinguished.

voterId.description: Canny identifier of the voter specified in the request.

FunctionOutput_canny_createvote.description: Acknowledgement that Canny accepted the vote request, without distinguishing creation from an existing vote.

tags.instructions: Use this to cast a vote for an existing Canny user on an existing post. You need their Canny identifiers, not the user's external identifier. Supply an administrator identifier only when voting on the user's behalf. For historical imports, supply the original creation time. Success does not distinguish a newly created vote from an existing vote or establish that existing vote metadata changed. Use `list-votes` with the post and voter filters to inspect the vote afterward, and `delete-vote` to remove it.

functions.name: delete-user

userId.description: Canny user ID to delete, not the application user ID.

FunctionInput_canny_deleteuser.description: The Canny user whose account and engagement should be deleted.

id.description: Canny identifier of the targeted user.

deleted.description: Canny acknowledged deletion and its documented engagement effects; no affected-record counts are supplied.

FunctionOutput_canny_deleteuser.description: Acknowledgement of user deletion and its documented engagement effects.

Posts with other engagement lose this author association. No restore guarantee is documented. Use `remove-user-from-company` for membership removal instead.

functions.name: delete-vote
functions.description: Delete the vote associated with a post and voter. An already absent vote is also a successful outcome.

postId.description: Canny identifier of the post whose vote should be removed.

voterId.description: Canny user identifier of the voter whose vote should be removed, not the external user ID.

FunctionInput_canny_deletevote.description: The post and Canny voter identifying the vote association to remove.

postId.description: Canny identifier of the post specified in the request.

status.description: Canny acknowledged that the vote was deleted or did not exist; these outcomes are not distinguished.

voterId.description: Canny identifier of the voter specified in the request.

FunctionOutput_canny_deletevote.description: Acknowledgement that the specified vote was deleted or was already absent.

tags.instructions: Use this to remove one user's vote from a post, not to delete the post or user. Obtain postId and voterId from your application or `list-votes`; a vote ID alone is not the deletion key. This removes the vote and does not offer an undelete operation. A later `create-vote` can cast a vote again but is not a restoration of the original vote's identity or metadata.

tags.instructions: Use this when you have a company name rather than its identifier. Use `list-companies` to browse with pagination. Canny name search provides no continuation; the result is not a promise that every possible match was returned.

The single provider search response, without a guarantee of exhaustive matches.

functions.name: send-feedback

text.description: Ordinary transcript or conversation text to analyze.

type.description: Use call for a call transcript and conversation for chat content.

sourceId.description: Unique identifier of the source call or conversation.

sourceUrl.description: Optional link to the original source.

sourceType.description: Optional source-system label, such as Zoom or twitter.

authorUserId.description: Author's identifier in your application, not their Canny record ID.

FunctionInput_canny_sendfeedback.description: Existing call transcript or chat conversation to enqueue for Autopilot analysis.

queued.description: Canny acknowledged queuing; extraction and deduplication are not complete.

FunctionOutput_canny_sendfeedback.description: Acknowledgment that Canny queued the submitted source, not completed extraction.

tags.instructions: Use this for existing call or conversation text, not to create a portal comment. Supply the author's application user ID and ensure that user already exists in Canny. Success means queued, not processed. Each request consumes one credit; manual-mode inbox capacity is 100 items. Do not blindly replay an uncertain result.

functions.name: update-company
functions.description: Partially update company details using the identifier supplied when the company was created. Other company-syncing integrations may overwrite these changes.

name.description: New company name; empty string intentionally clears it.

domain.description: Bare domain without protocol, path, whitespace or port; omission leaves unchanged.

companyId.description: Original company identifier, not an unrelated Canny user or company slug.

createdAt.description: Company creation instant in your system, with explicit offset; omission leaves unchanged.

customFields.description: Complete replacement custom-field map; empty object clears all custom fields. Top-level null is not accepted.

anyOf.description: Null custom-field value; not a deletion instruction.

monthlySpend.description: Monthly recurring revenue in dollars, at cent precision; zero is an explicit value.

FunctionInput_canny_updatecompany.description: Original company identifier and at least one company field to change.

id.description: Company identifier returned by the successful update; not a guarantee against later sync overwrites.

FunctionOutput_canny_updatecompany.description: Identifier returned by Canny after updating the company.

tags.instructions: Find the company using `list-companies` or `search-companies`, or use its original application identifier. Supply only fields to change. Empty name clears the name; customFields is a replacement map. Null clearing is not offered. Existing HubSpot, Salesforce, SSO or Identify syncing may later overwrite the result.

functions.name: update-post
functions.description: Partially update a post's content, ETA, images, custom fields or owner. Owner changes require an authorized acting admin.

title.description: Replacement title; omitted leaves it unchanged.

postId.description: Canny post to modify.

details.description: Replacement details; empty string clears text and omission leaves it unchanged.

ownerId.description: Replacement admin owner ID; null removes owner. Either form requires changerId.

etaMonth.description: Replacement calendar month YYYY-MM; null clears ETA and omission preserves it.

changerId.description: Acting admin ID with permission to change owners.

etaPublic.description: Replacement ETA visibility; omission preserves it.

imageUrls.description: Complete replacement image list; empty removes all and omission preserves existing images.

items.description: URL of an image to include in the replacement image list.

customFields.description: Patch of custom-field names to JSON values. Unmentioned keys are preserved; null is a field value, not a delete instruction.

additionalProperties.description: JSON field value; strings are at most 199 characters and null is a value, not deletion.

FunctionInput_canny_updatepost.description: A partial post update containing a post ID and at least one replacement field.

id.description: Canny identifier of the targeted post.

updated.description: Canny acknowledged the requested update; not a claim about downstream notifications.

FunctionOutput_canny_updatepost.description: Acknowledgement of the requested post update.

tags.instructions: Get the post ID from `get-post` or `list-posts`. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Null clears ETA or owner; an empty image array removes all images. Owner changes require changerId. Use `update-post-status`, `update-post-category` or `move-post` for those tasks.

functions.description: Change a post's status as an admin, optionally attaching a comment and notifying non-admin voters.

postId.description: Canny post whose status changes.

status.description: Exact built-in or custom workspace status name.

This changes lifecycle state and may create activity and notifications. Repeating the current status does not trigger status-change side effects or attach a new status comment.

functions.name: upsert-user
functions.description: Create an end-user when no matching account exists, or update supplied profile data and add company associations for an existing user.

name.description: User name, required by Canny even on update; admin names cannot be modified.

alias.description: Replacement anonymized-board alias; omission preserves existing value.

email.description: Email to supply when matching by Canny or application ID; must agree with match.email if both supplied.
Unique email matching key, copied without local case normalization.

userId.description: Existing Canny user ID; an unknown ID is an error, not a new identity to invent.

externalUserId.description: Stable application user ID, preserved as an opaque string.

match.description: Exactly one unique matching key within the connected workspace; the same key is supplied to Canny for creation or update.

avatarUrl.description: Replacement avatar URL; omission preserves it. Admin avatars cannot be modified.

companies.description: Companies to associate or update; omitted or empty never removes existing associations. User must have an application ID.

domain.description: Company domain, such as acme.com, when supplied.

customFields.description: Company custom fields supplied for this company; unmentioned values are intended to be preserved.

monthlySpend.description: Monthly spend supplied to Canny, with at most two decimal places and no currency conversion.

sourceCreatedAt.description: Company creation instant in the source application, with explicit timezone.

items.description: Company association and supplied company profile data.

customFields.description: Custom-field patch preserving unmentioned keys; null values are supplied as values, not deletion commands.

externalUserId.description: Application ID to associate when matching by Canny ID or email; must agree with match.externalUserId if both supplied.

sourceCreatedAt.description: Creation instant in your source application, with explicit timezone; not the Canny account creation time.

FunctionInput_canny_upsertuser.description: Unique user identity, required name, and optional profile and company patches.

id.description: Canny user identifier returned after creation or update; does not indicate which occurred.

FunctionOutput_canny_upsertuser.description: Canny user identifier acknowledged by the native upsert.

tags.instructions: Use a stable application user ID, email or Canny ID to match an account. `get-user` can resolve these IDs first. Admin email, name and avatar cannot be changed through the API. Company associations require an application user ID; omitting a company never removes it. Use `remove-user-from-company` to disassociate one. Use `get-user` afterward for the profile.
